title: Grandiosity
description: A client-side Fabric-based modpack giving vanilla Minecraft a grandiose experience.

About

Grandiosity is a vanilla-plus themed modpack for Fabric 1.21 that is client-side only; The modpack allows for an overhauled vanilla feel wherever you play - Whether a server or singleplayer. Grandiosity includes features and tweaks such as: - Immersive animations, particles, and massive visual overhauls. - An overhauled sound system: New sound effects for nearly every action in the game, as well as ambiance and sound physics. - In-game voice chat. - Replay mod for recording. - Multiple performance mods.
